 The above preamble/recitals shall be deemed to constitute an integral part of this Agreement which shall be construed accordingly. 
 
 Words importing the singular also include the plural and the masculine includes the feminine and vice versa, unless the context otherwise requires.

 TERM AND SCOPE 
 
 The Sub-Licensor hereby grants to the Sub-Licensee , a conditional sub-licence to occupy the Unit subject to the terms and condition s of the License along with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement ( “Sub-License” ), for a period of [●] months commencing from [●] and ending [●] ( “Term” ) . 
 
 The S ub- L icence is personal to the Sub-Licensee, is non-transferable and non- assignable. 
 
 Th is Sub- L icense does not create a landlord – tenant relationship between the Sub-Licensor and the Sub-Licensee. 
 
 The Sub-Licensee understands and acknowledges that the Sub- License is a conditional permission to occupy the u nit and does not create or transfer any rights, title or interest in the u nit in favour of the Sub-Licensor or the S ub- L icensee except to the extent envisaged under the License Terms.

 The Sub-Licensor hereby represents and warrants that it has the necessary permissions and the right to sub-license the Unit subject to the terms and conditions contained in therein .

For avoidance of doubt any change in the terms of the License , expiry or termination thereof, shall be deemed as a change in terms of the Sub -L icense , expiry or termination thereof, whatever the case may be .

 7. REPRESENTATIONS OF THE SUB-LICENSEE 
 
 The Sub-Licensee hereby represents , warrants and undertakes that: 
 
 h e /she has full legal capacity and power to enter into, exercise its rights and perform its obligations under this Agreement and carry on the business envisaged hereunder; 
 
 he/she shall not make any permanent structural change, modification, alteration or addition to the Unit; 
 
 he/she will, at his/her sole expense, keep and maintain the Unit in good and sanitary condition and repair during the Term of this Sub-License. Sub-Licensee shall keep the fixtures in the Unit in good order and repair, subject to normal wear and tear; and 
 
 he/she shall, at his/her sole expense, make all required repairs to the plumbing, range, oven, electric motor, geysers, heating apparatus, electric and gas fixtures, other mechanical devices and systems, floors, ceilings and walls whenever damage to such items shall have resulted from Sub-Licensee's misuse or negligence. 
 
 8. TERMINATION 
 
 The Sub -L icense granted here in shall stand immediately terminated : 
 
 u pon one (1) months’ notice by either party that wishes to terminate this Agreement for any reason whatsoever ; 
 
 upon lapse of the License p eriod or its termination for any reason whatsoever; 
 
 upon expiry of the notice period issued by the Sub-Licensor for breach of this Agreement by the Sub-Licensee which has not been remedied within specified time; and 
 
 upon default on payment of any sums due under this Agreement. 
 
 Upon termination of this Agreement : 
 
 the Sub-Licensee shall quit and surrender the Unit in good condition subject to normal wear and tear; 
 
 the Sub-Licensee shall peacefully handover the vacant possession of the Unit to the Sub-Licensor or the Licensor, as the case maybe, within 30 (thirty) days ; and 
 
 The Sub-Licensor shall return the amount of Security Deposit or forfeit the same in the event of default on payment of Sub -L icense Fee , Service Charges , utilities or any damage caused to the Unit by the Sub - Licensee.

 MISCELLANEOUS CLAUSES 
 
 10.1 If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or otherwise unenforceable, the enforceability of the remaining provisions shall not be impaired thereby. In such case, the Parties shall make every effort to replace the ineffective provision with a new provision which has the same effect, or as approximate an effect as possible as the said provision. 
 
 The Agreement may only be amended / modified in writing and signed by both Parties subject to approval from the Licensor . 
 
 The terms and conditions of this Agreement , the Agreement to Sell along with its annexures constitute the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede any prior understandings, agreements or representations by or between the Parties, written or oral. There are no understandings, representations or warranties of any kind whatsoever which shall form an integral part hereof. 
 
 This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the competent courts at Lahore shall have the exclusive jurisdiction to settle matters arising in respect of this Agreement. 
 
 This Agreement may be executed in 2 (two) counterparts and a copy to be held by each Party. This has the same effect as if the signatures or the counterparts were on a single copy of this Agreement.
